minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  December 15, 2020

The Successor Agency of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
Tuesday, December 15, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
Mayor Butts called the City Council into Joint Session with the Successor Agency at the
hour of 1:01 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as
follows:
  Present:  Mayor Butts/Successor Agency Chairman, Council
  Members/Successor Agency Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales and Faulk; and
  Absent:  None.
City/Successor Agency officials and personnel present for closed session were as
follows:

  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Jacquelyn Gordon  Staff Assistant

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEMS.  Mayor
/Successor Agency Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present who
wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency on the Closed Session Item Nos.
CS-1, CS-2, and CSA-1.

There was no response.

Mayor /Successor Agency Chairman Butts recessed the City Council/Successor Agency
at the hour of 1:01 p.m. for Closed Session Item Nos. CS-1, CS-2, and CSA-1.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority at the
hour of 2:03 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary announced the
presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts/Council Members/Successor Agency
  Members/Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales, and Faulk; and
  Absent:  None.
City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as
follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director* (Arrived at 2:30 p.m.)
  Louis Atwell  Asst. City Manager
  Wanda Brown  City Treasurer/Treasurer*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Jacquelyn Gordon  Staff Assistant

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority.

  1
 December 15, 2020

  Assembly Member Autumn Burke presented Council Member Franklin and Council
  Member Faulk with a Certificate of Recognition from the State of California.

  Assembly Member Autumn Burke administered the Oath of Office to Council Member
  Faulk.

  The City Council presented the 2020 Year-in-Review Video for the City of Inglewood.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present
  who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority on any
  item on the Agendas, other than the Public Hearing.
  Caller (Name Unknown) spoke concerning Agenda Item No. 4, resolution approving an
  appraisal of the fair market value of City parks, and the video presentation.

  Gil Mathieu, District 4, commented on Agenda Item Nos. 4, 5, 9-12, and PH-1.

 142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member/
  Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Morales, and seconded by
  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Dotson that the
  demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated
  December 10, 2020, in the amount of $3,267,748.40 are hereby allowed, and the City
  Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to
  certify upon said registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 132.6  CLOSED SESSION – REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATIONS WITH 10004 S.
  INGLEWOOD AVE. INGLEWOOD, CA 90301: GOOD WILL CLAIM FOR
  CHURCH’S CHICKEN; CLAIMANT NEGOTIATING PARTY: SULLIVAN,
  WORKMAN AND DEE. Closed session – Confidential – City Council and Successor
  Agency Board Members Conference with Legal Counsel Regarding Pending Litigation,
  Real Property Negotiations, Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.8; 10004 S.
  Inglewood Ave. Inglewood, CA 90301: Good Will claim for Church’s Chicken; Claimant
  Negotiating Party: Sullivan, Workman and Dee; City/Agency Negotiator: Artie Fields,
  City Manager/Executive Director; Under Negotiations: Price and Terms of Good Will
  Compensation.

  It was moved by Council Member/Successor Agency Member Morales, and seconded by
  Council Member/ Successor Agency Member Dotson that the City Council/Successor
  Agency does hereby approve request for settlement in the amount of $82,500. The
  motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk,
  and Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  There being no further business to be presented, Chairman Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned in memory of Johnathan Fedoza at the hour of 2:54 p.m.

  Approved this 22nd day of June, 2021.
  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, Secretary

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Chairman
